rules.headingNeedsPlace: A heading needs the place: true north is found from the device location, so a record with no place carries no heading.
rules.headingInsideLimit: A measured heading has an accuracy inside the limit; outside it, the record says there is no heading and why.
rules.noPlaceReasonNeedsNoPlace: No heading for want of a place needs a record with no place.
rules.outsideLimitCarriesAccuracy: A heading left out for its accuracy carries the accuracy the device reported, and that accuracy is outside the limit.
rules.onlyOutsideLimitReportsAccuracy: Only a heading left out for its accuracy carries a reported accuracy.
rules.unitQuaternion: The attitude is a unit quaternion, as Core Motion reports it.
rules.gravityNearOneG: Gravity is given in g, so its length lies inside the stated band around one g: a zero vector, or one written in metres per second squared, is refused.
rules.sampleAtThePhoto: The motion sample is the one at the photo: its time lies within the limit of the photo timestamp.
rules.windowRunsForward: The motion window runs forward: it ends no earlier than it starts.
rules.placeholderSha256: A SHA-256 of 64 zeros is a placeholder, not a hash.
